scripts.e2e:setup: cd e2e && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun x playwright install chromium
scripts.validate: bun run workflow:test && bun run agent:check && bun run format:check && bun run codegen:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.security: bun run security:audit && bun run security:secrets && bun run security:sast
scripts.security:image: sh -c 'if [ -f apps/api/Dockerfile ]; then docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t nightwatch-api:trivy-scan . && trivy image --exit-code 1 --severity HIGH,CRITICAL nightwatch-api:trivy-scan; else echo "security:image: no apps/api/Dockerfile yet (lands in wave T9); skipping trivy image scan"; fi'
